title: "continuous_response_calcs"
author: "Kathy Condon"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

Purpose: take full plot-level data from **"VAR_filtered.csv"** files into daily averages (at the treatment instead of plot level -- **"continuous_long_dailyavs.csv"**) and calculates relative 20% thresholds, response lengths (days > threshold) and response AUC's (magnitude and legnth together) exported as **"continuous_response_calcs.csv"**

```{r start file linking - setup del info to add in to data}
# list continuous data files for looping (next chunk)
con.dat<-list(VWC=VWC.dat,GCC=GCC.dat,SR=SR.dat)
con.labels<-list("20 cm VWC (%)","GCC","Efflux")

# add deluge characteristics data to merge with
del.info<-read.csv("deluge/data/deluge_characteristics_mergeable.csv")%>%
  # create Study_trt to match what's in the continuous data files
  mutate(Study_trt=paste0(Study_shorthand,"_",trt))
str(del.info)

# add treatment key that links each trt to it's control 
del.trts<-read.csv("deluge/data/deluge_trt_keys.csv")%>%
  # format start and end dates to as.Date
  mutate(del_start=as.Date(del_start,format="%m/%d/%y"),
         del_end=as.Date(del_end,format="%m/%d/%y"))%>%
  # add column that gives end of 28-day standard response period
  mutate(resp_28day=del_start+28)%>%
  # join in deluge characteristics from del.info
  left_join(del.info %>% select(Study_shorthand,year,trt,del_size,timing),
            by=c("Study_shorthand","year","trt"))%>%
  # also save dates in DOY format
  mutate(del_start_doy=yday(del_start),
         del_end_doy=yday(del_end),
         resp_28day_doy=yday(resp_28day))

```

#### 2. Calculating Response Metrics ********************************************
######## a. Relative 20% threshold
```{r 2a relative threshold - daily responses}
#### settings ####
thresh<-0.20 # response = treatment-control difference > 20% of the variable's range
# thresh<-0.10
#### range for each variable -- calculated across ALL studies, locations, and years ####
# (min/max of treatment-level daily averages; duplicated controls don't change min/max)
var.range<-cont.avs%>%
  group_by(Variable,
           Study_shorthand
           )%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    min.val=min(trt.day.av,na.rm=TRUE), ## fix to take min/max of trt or control
    max.val=max(trt.day.av,na.rm=TRUE),
    var.range=max.val-min.val,
    .groups="drop")
var.range

#### put each deluge trt side-by-side with its own control ####
# deluge trt rows -- add name of the control trt each is paired with
del.avs<-cont.avs%>%
  filter(con_vs_trt=="trt")%>%
  left_join(del.trts%>%select(Study_shorthand,year,trt,con,del_start),
            by=c("Study_shorthand","year","trt","del_start"))

# control rows (copies already duplicated per deluge trt, so del_size/timing/del_start match their deluge trt)
con.avs<-cont.avs%>%
  filter(con_vs_trt=="con")%>%
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,date,con=trt,del_size,timing,del_start,
         con.day.av=trt.day.av,con.day.SE=trt.day.SE)

wide.daily.avs<-del.avs%>%
  left_join(con.avs,
            by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","date","con","del_size","timing","del_start"))%>%
  left_join(var.range%>%select(Variable,var.range),by="Variable")%>%
  # relative difference -- like %difference but divided by range instead of CON
  mutate(
    diff=trt.day.av-con.day.av,
    rel.diff=diff/var.range,
    response=case_when(
      is.na(rel.diff) ~ NA_character_, # no paired control measurement that date
      rel.diff > thresh ~ "positive",
      rel.diff < -thresh ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ "none"))%>%
  arrange(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,date)

# view(wide.daily.avs)

# check what rows were used as the min/max for each var
cont.avs%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand)%>%
  slice_min(trt.day.av,n=1)%>% # and slice_min for the low end
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,date,trt,trt.day.av,n.plots.per.date) # all have at least 4 plots per date

#### plot check relative thresholds ####
# check.var<-"SR"
# check.var<-"VWC"
check.var<-"GCC"

plot.dat<-cont.avs%>%
  filter(Variable==check.var)%>%
  mutate(Study_trt=paste0(Study_shorthand,"_",trt),
         trt_type=factor(con_vs_trt,levels=c("con","trt"),labels=c("CON","DEL")))

# 28-day response period shading
resp_rects<-plot.dat%>%
  filter(!is.na(del_start),!is.na(resp_28day))%>%
  distinct(Study_shorthand,year,del_start,resp_28day)

# dates over threshold
flagged.dates<-wide.daily.avs%>%
  filter(Variable==check.var,response %in% c("positive","negative"))

thresh.check<-ggplot(plot.dat,aes(x=date,y=trt.day.av,group=trt,linetype=trt_type,color=Study_trt))+
  geom_rect(data=resp_rects,aes(xmin=del_start,xmax=resp_28day,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf),
            inherit.aes=FALSE,fill="grey80",alpha=0.3)+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=trt.day.av-trt.day.SE,ymax=trt.day.av+trt.day.SE),width=0.2)+
  # triangles mark dates over the threshold (up = positive, down = negative)
  geom_point(data=flagged.dates,aes(x=date,y=trt.day.av,shape=response),
             inherit.aes=FALSE,color="black",fill="black",size=2.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c("positive"=24,"negative"=25))+
  scale_x_date(date_labels="%b %d")+
  labs(x="Date",y=check.var,linetype="Treatment")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  force_panelsizes(rows=unit(2.25,"in"),
                   cols=unit(4.25,"in"))+
  facet_wrap(~Study_shorthand+year,scales="free")
thresh.check

#### *** export continuous_long_dailyavs.csv -- daily treatment averages + deluge info + threshold columns *** ####
daily.out<-bind_rows(
  cont.avs%>%
    filter(con_vs_trt=="trt")%>%
    left_join(wide.daily.avs%>%
                select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,date,del_start,
                       con,con.day.av,var.range,rel.diff,response),
              by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt","date","del_start")),
  cont.avs%>%
    filter(con_vs_trt=="con"))%>%
  arrange(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,date)

nrow(cont.avs)
nrow(daily.out) # should match
```

```{r 2a relative threshold - consecutive response runs and lengths}
#### only look at paired dates AFTER the deluge started ####
resp.dat<-wide.daily.avs%>%
  filter(!is.na(response),date>del_start)%>%
  arrange(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,date)

#### fill single-day interruptions using previous and next dates ####
filled.responses<-resp.dat%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt)%>%
  mutate(prev_resp=lag(response),
         next_resp=lead(response),
         response.filled=case_when(
           ## single day with a response, both sides are none -> replace with none
           response != "none" & prev_resp=="none" & next_resp=="none" ~ "none",
           ## both sides are positive -> replace with positive
           response != "positive" & prev_resp=="positive" & next_resp=="positive" ~ "positive",
           ## both sides are negative -> replace with negative
           response != "negative" & prev_resp=="negative" & next_resp=="negative" ~ "negative",
           ## keep all others the same
           TRUE ~ response))%>%
  ## identify consecutive runs
  mutate(run_id=rleid(response.filled))%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,run_id)%>%
  mutate(run_response=first(response.filled))%>%
  ungroup()

# view(filled.responses)

#### summary of every positive/negative run ####
response.runs.summary<-filled.responses%>%
  # drop any runs of "none"
  filter(run_response %in% c("positive","negative"))%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,run_id,run_response)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    run_start=min(date),
    run_end=max(date),
    # calendar days (start and end date both counted)
    n_cal_days=as.numeric(run_end-run_start)+1,
    # measured dates actually over the threshold (excludes filled single-day gaps)
    n_days_over_thresh=sum(response==run_response),
    .groups="drop")%>%
  # drop single-day responses (edge cases not fixed by the filling rules)
  filter(n_cal_days>1)

# view(response.runs.summary)

#### one "primary" response run per treatment = the longest run (earliest if tied) ####
primary.run<-response.runs.summary%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt)%>%
  arrange(desc(n_cal_days),run_start,.by_group=TRUE)%>%
  mutate(n_runs=n())%>%
  slice(1)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  rename(new_resp_direction=run_response,
         new_resp_start=run_start,
         new_resp_end=run_end,
         new_resp_length=n_cal_days,
         new_resp_n_days_over=n_days_over_thresh,
         new_resp_n_runs=n_runs)%>%
  select(-run_id)

#### first post-deluge measurement date (and number of paired dates available) ####
resp.obs<-resp.dat%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    post_del_firstobs_date=min(date),
    n_paired_obs_post=n(),
    .groups="drop")
```

######## b. AUC based on 28-day response period
```{r 2b AUC over 28-day response period}
#### helper: trapezoidal AUC between two dates, interpolating onto the boundaries ####
# returns NA if observations do not cover both boundaries (start and end)
auc_window<-function(date,y,start,end){
  d<-as.numeric(date); s<-as.numeric(start); e<-as.numeric(end)
  keep<-!is.na(y)
  d<-d[keep]; y<-y[keep]
  if(length(d)<2 || min(d)>s || max(d)<e) return(NA_real_)
  o<-order(d); d<-d[o]; y<-y[o]
  inside<-d>s & d<e
  x.all<-c(s,d[inside],e)
  y.all<-c(approx(d,y,xout=s)$y,y[inside],approx(d,y,xout=e)$y)
  pracma::trapz(x.all,y.all)
}

#### check studies missing observations before/after the 28-day boundaries ####
missing.bounds<-cont.avs%>%
  filter(!is.na(del_start),!is.na(resp_28day))%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,con_vs_trt,del_start,resp_28day)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    first_date=min(date),
    last_date=max(date),
    n=n(),
    .groups="drop")%>%
  # observations start after deluge started OR end before the response period ended
  filter(first_date>del_start | last_date<resp_28day)
# view(missing.bounds) # these get AUC = NA below

#### AUC for every treatment and control series (deluge start -> 28 days later) ####
auc.28<-cont.avs%>%
  filter(!is.na(del_start),!is.na(resp_28day))%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,con_vs_trt,del_size,timing,del_start,del_end,resp_28day)%>%
  arrange(date,.by_group=TRUE)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    AUC28=auc_window(date,trt.day.av,del_start[1],resp_28day[1]),
    .groups="drop")

#### pair each deluge trt with its control ####
auc28.del<-auc.28%>%
  filter(con_vs_trt=="trt")%>%
  left_join(del.trts%>%select(Study_shorthand,year,trt,con,del_start),
            by=c("Study_shorthand","year","trt","del_start"))%>%
  rename(AUC28_del=AUC28)

auc28.con<-auc.28%>%
  filter(con_vs_trt=="con")%>%
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,con=trt,del_size,timing,del_start,AUC28_con=AUC28)

auc28.diff<-auc28.del%>%
  left_join(auc28.con,
            by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","con","del_size","timing","del_start"))%>%
  mutate(
    diff_AUC28=AUC28_del-AUC28_con,
    diff_AUC28_daily=diff_AUC28/28)%>% # average daily response over the 28 days
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,con,del_size,timing,del_start,del_end,resp_28day,
         AUC28_del,AUC28_con,diff_AUC28,diff_AUC28_daily)

# view(auc28.diff)
```

######## c. AUC based on 20% threshold elevated period
```{r 2c AUC over threshold-elevated period}
# integrate deluge and control over the primary response run (new_resp_start -> new_resp_end)
# uses paired measurement dates only, and run start/end are measured dates, so no interpolation needed
auc.thresh<-primary.run%>%
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,new_resp_start,new_resp_end)%>%
  left_join(resp.dat%>%select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,date,trt.day.av,con.day.av),
            by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt"))%>%
  filter(date>=new_resp_start,date<=new_resp_end)%>%
  group_by(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt)%>%
  arrange(date,.by_group=TRUE)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    AUCthresh_del=pracma::trapz(as.numeric(date),trt.day.av),
    AUCthresh_con=pracma::trapz(as.numeric(date),con.day.av),
    span_days=as.numeric(max(date)-min(date)),
    .groups="drop")%>%
  mutate(
    diff_AUCthresh=AUCthresh_del-AUCthresh_con,
    # average daily response over the elevated period
    diff_AUCthresh_daily=diff_AUCthresh/span_days)%>%
  select(-span_days)

# view(auc.thresh)
```

#### 3. Merge Treatment-Level Data & Responses Metrics
```{r 3 merge and export}
# one row per Variable x deluge treatment
trt.base<-wide.daily.avs%>%
  distinct(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,con,del_size,timing,del_start,del_end,resp_28day,var.range)

continuous.response.calcs<-trt.base%>%
  # 28-day AUC's
  left_join(auc28.diff%>%
              select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,del_start,
                     AUC28_del,AUC28_con,diff_AUC28,diff_AUC28_daily),
            by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt","del_start"))%>%
  # first post-deluge measurement
  left_join(resp.obs,by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt"))%>%
  # relative threshold response length
  left_join(primary.run%>%
              select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,new_resp_direction,new_resp_start,new_resp_end,
                     new_resp_length,new_resp_n_days_over,new_resp_n_runs),
            by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt"))%>%
  # threshold-period AUC's
  left_join(auc.thresh,by=c("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt"))%>%
  mutate(
    # days from first post-deluge measurement to start of the response
    new_resp_lag_days=as.numeric(new_resp_start-post_del_firstobs_date),
    # treatments WITH post-deluge paired data but NO run over the threshold = 0 days / 0 AUC (NA if never measured)
    has_obs=!is.na(post_del_firstobs_date),
    new_resp_n_runs=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(new_resp_n_runs,0L),NA_integer_),
    new_resp_length=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(new_resp_length,0),NA_real_),
    new_resp_n_days_over=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(new_resp_n_days_over,0L),NA_integer_),
    AUCthresh_del=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(AUCthresh_del,0),NA_real_),
    AUCthresh_con=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(AUCthresh_con,0),NA_real_),
    diff_AUCthresh=if_else(has_obs,coalesce(diff_AUCthresh,0),NA_real_))%>%
  select(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt,con,del_size,timing,
         del_start,del_end,resp_28day,var.range,
         # 28-day response period
         AUC28_del,AUC28_con,diff_AUC28,diff_AUC28_daily,
         # relative 20% threshold response
         post_del_firstobs_date,n_paired_obs_post,
         new_resp_direction,new_resp_start,new_resp_end,new_resp_length,
         new_resp_n_days_over,new_resp_n_runs,new_resp_lag_days,
         # AUC over threshold-elevated period
         AUCthresh_del,AUCthresh_con,diff_AUCthresh,diff_AUCthresh_daily)

# checks -- should be one row per Variable x deluge trt
nrow(trt.base)
nrow(continuous.response.calcs)
continuous.response.calcs%>%
  dplyr::count(Variable,Study_shorthand,year,trt)%>%
  filter(n>1)
```

```{r make metadata file for these columns}
cat(paste0('"', names(continuous.response.calcs), '" ~ "",'), sep = "\n")

metadat<-tibble(column=names(continuous.response.calcs))%>%
  mutate(
    description=case_match(column,
                           "Variable" ~ "GCC, VWC, or SR response variable that calculations correpond to",
                           "Study_shorthand" ~ "shorthand name",
                           "year" ~ "study year",
                           "trt" ~ "deluge treatment name",
                           "con" ~ "corresponding control treatment name",
                           "del_size" ~ "deluge size (mm)",
                           "timing" ~ "deluge timing (early/mid/late/fall)",
                           "del_start" ~ "date deluage water additions began",
                           "del_end" ~ "date deluge water addiitons end",
                           "resp_28day" ~ "date of end of 28-day 'standard' response period",
                           "var.range" ~ "range for variable response across all studies and years",
                           "AUC28_del" ~ "AUC of deluge treatment based on 28-day response period",
                           "AUC28_con" ~ "AUC of control treatment based on 28-day response period",
                           "diff_AUC28" ~ "AUC28_del - AUC28_con",
                           "diff_AUC28_daily" ~ "diff_AUC28/28 days",
                           "post_del_firstobs_date" ~ "date of first measurements after deluge addition",
                           "n_paired_obs_post" ~ "number of observations post-deluge",
                           "new_resp_direction" ~ "direction (positive or negative) of primary response run -- longest consecutive days where trt-con/var.range > threshold",
                           "new_resp_start" ~ "first date of primary response run post-deluge",
                           "new_resp_end" ~ "end date of primary response run post-deluge (trt-con/var.range < threshold again)",
                           "new_resp_length" ~ "number of days between new_resp_start and new_resp_end",
                           "new_resp_n_days_over" ~ "number of observation dates in the new response period that were over the threshold (excludes single dates < threshold in the period)",
                           "new_resp_n_runs" ~ "total number of response runs - mostly 0 for no response or 1 but theoretically if there was a pause and second response period, this could be 2+",
                           "new_resp_lag_days" ~ "days between post_del_firstobs_date to new_resp_start",
                           "AUCthresh_del" ~ "AUC of del trts over each study/year/variable's primary response run",
                           "AUCthresh_con" ~ "AUC of con trts over each study/year/variable's primary response run",
                           "diff_AUCthresh" ~ "AUCthresh_del - AUCthresh_con",
                           "diff_AUCthresh_daily" ~ "diff_AUCthresh/new_resp_length",
                           
  ))
  
  
metadat%>%filter(is.na(description)) # all described
```
